title: 'Lal Salaam', Secret Apps, 'If Someone Dies…': Explosive 'Sansad Chalo' Chats Reveal CJP Protest Playbook
description: Republic has accessed alleged WhatsApp chats linked to the July 20 'Sansad Chalo' protest that appear to discuss creating pressure on the government, preparing for communication blackouts using encrypted apps and encouraging ‘extreme sacrifice’.
